title: Firmware version concatenation can overwrite the focuser INFO item
summary: Category security; severity medium; confidence high. Owner coordinator; open, nonblocking audit follow-up. Location: indigo_drivers/focuser_primaluce/indigo_focuser_primaluce.driver:570-573. The application firmware is copied with INDIGO_COPY_VALUE into INFO_DEVICE_FW_REVISION_ITEM->text.value (512 bytes); the code then appends / and the web firmware string using unchecked strcat. Even a first string truncated to511 leaves no room for the separator. The second string comes directly from an8192-byte device reply (shared/primalucelib/primalucelib.h:77,502; primalucelib.c:416-421 returns the decoded token pointer without a per-value cap). This is a malformed/oversized device-reply memory overwrite, distinct from FND-000052 concerning client WiFi JSON escaping. Fix by formatting the combined version into a bounded destination, preserving values before any shared-buffer reuse. Verify large individual/combined firmware fields via local fake transport; no oversized reply was generated here. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (FM-1). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
